comparison_scope: Low-cost input/output contract review against the local route planner and audit-finding comparator. No same-task outcome, security efficacy, or cost comparison was run.
candidate_function: Report exact string-set additions and removals between two caller-supplied declared grant snapshots bound to the same policy and subject.

adjacent_existing_tools.observed_contract: Proposes a sufficient set of operation IDs from exact task input/output types and caller allowlists; validates candidate permission-card shape but does not compare two policy snapshots.
adjacent_existing_tools.not_a_replacement_because: A task route proposal does not report before/after declared grant additions and removals or inspect an effective sandbox.

adjacent_existing_tools.observed_contract: Compares two caller-declared audit finding sets under a shared target binding.
adjacent_existing_tools.not_a_replacement_because: It compares review findings, not exact capability/scope grant declarations.

paired_same_task_trial.reason: The neighboring tools take typed task-route or audit-finding inputs, not a pair of policy declarations; coercing them would not be a fair same-task comparison.
paired_same_task_trial.next_low_cost_comparison: If a real non-sensitive policy review uses both declarations and audit findings, record which distinct reviewer questions each answers and any human rework.

retirement_decision.reason: No paired outcome supports superiority, replacement, or retirement; keep the optional tool default-off and preserve uncertainty.

negative_controls: Unknown capabilities, duplicate grants, duplicate JSON keys, mismatched policy/subject bindings, extra fields, and oversized inputs fail closed.
A new declaration is labeled for review; the comparator does not decide whether a grant is semantically broader or acceptable.
A removed declaration is not called safe automatically; a literal wildcard marker is compared as an uninterpreted exact string.
No result is described as effective sandbox state, enforcement, permission, approval, or security assurance.
claim_ceiling: Synthetic contract and exact set-difference behavior only; no sandbox efficacy, actual security improvement, or relative cost benefit is established.
